description: Lightkeeper brand tokens, the machine-readable twin of docs/BRAND.md. Presentation only: what a screen says comes from spec/display_vectors.json, never from here. tests/test_brand_tokens.py keeps this file, docs/BRAND.md and the measured contrast in step. A surface that draws with these colors tests its own values against this file.
contrast: WCAG 2.2 contrast ratio from relative luminance, sRGB channels linearized below 0.04045

ink.name: Ink
ink.role: Text on light, tower on light

line.name: Line
line.role: Decorative dividers; control borders use Line strong

beam.name: Beam
beam.role: Accent: the lamp, rules, focus rings, text of 24 px or more

line-strong.name: Line strong
line-strong.role: Borders that identify a control, panel bezels, card edges

beam-text.name: Beam text
beam-text.role: Links, eyebrows, and any accent text under 24 px

chip-in-range.name: In range chip
chip-in-range.role: Tint behind the IN RANGE word

chip-low.name: Low chip
chip-low.role: Tint behind the LOW and URGENT LOW words

chip-high.name: High chip
chip-high.role: Tint behind the HIGH and URGENT HIGH words

chip-stale.name: Stale chip
chip-stale.role: Tint behind the STALE and NO DATA words

band-text.name: Band text
band-text.role: Words on an Ink band and on a pressed control

night-paper.name: Night paper
night-paper.role: Panel previews in dark mode, so the panel is never the brightest thing at the bedside

plain.screen: Ink word on its chip, 2 px green border while IN RANGE neutral stays proposed

rule.panel: 2 px rule under the headline, full content width
rule.screen: Ink word on its chip, 2 px status border

inverse.panel: Inverse band: paper glyphs on ink, 2 px pad
inverse.screen: Ink band with the word in Band text, 4 px status-color leading rule

stale.panel: Inverse band, a 4 px hatch-45 frame inside the margin, and a strike through the last: line (1 px at scale 2 or less, 2 px at scale 3 and up)
stale.screen: Ink band with the word in Band text, hatch in the margin only, the last: line struck through

dashed.panel: 2 px dashed frame (4 on, 4 off), no number
dashed.screen: 2 px dashed Line strong frame, no number

dither-12.use: Margins, bezels, headers and empty states

dither-25.use: Margins, bezels, headers and empty states; Line in 1-bit, inside frames only

dither-50.use: Margins, bezels, headers and empty states

hatch-45.use: The STALE frame only; inks the pixels where x + y is a multiple of 4, counted from the image's top-left pixel

in-range-neutral.rule: On glance surfaces, IN RANGE gets an Ink border and no green

night-profile.rule: Never a whole-UI red tint, because red means LOW
